title: Exotic Chinese Squid Salt And Pepper Squid
description: A rich and bouncy Chinese dish featuring ancho chillies, perfect for a quick fix, flexitarian-friendly meal, served on a talavera plate.

ingredients.name: squid tubes
ingredients.notes: cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Rinse the squid pieces in cold water and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a bowl, mix together the cornstarch, salt, and black pepper.
Add the squid pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the cornstarch mixture.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Add the crushed ancho chillies to the oil and stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add the garlic and ginger to the oil and stir-fry for another minute.
Add the squid pieces to the oil and stir-fry until they are opaque and lightly browned.
Remove the squid from the oil and place on a talavera plate to serve.
